description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of frames and accuracy percentage for four different models. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Frames", has a linear scale, ranges from 8 to 64, and is marked at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", also has a linear scale, spans from 40 to 54, and is marked at intervals of 2. The blue line, representing "Ours (Dynamic Seg)", starts at around 52.8% accuracy at 8 frames and increases to approximately 54.1% at 64 frames, with a solid line style and circle markers. The green line, representing "Ours (Static 4-Seg)", begins at around 52.6% accuracy at 8 frames and rises to about 54% at 16 frames, remaining steady thereafter, also with a solid line style and circle markers. The orange line, representing an unnamed model, starts at around 45% accuracy at 8 frames and decreases to approximately 39.5% at 64 frames, with a solid line style and square markers. The red line, representing "PLLaVA (DP 16)", begins at around 46.5% accuracy at 8 frames and declines to about 42% at 64 frames, with a solid line style and square markers.
